answer_1.quote: Natural Language to Visualization (NL2VIS) plays a crucial role in transforming natural-language descriptions into visual representations (e.g., charts, plots, and histograms) grounded on tabular data.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance using both rule-based and model-based metrics for quantitative and qualitative assessment.

answer_3.quote: Readability Score is the average score ranging from 0 to 5 assigned by MLLM-as-a-Judge to assess their visual clarity for legal visualization.
